comment: Single source of truth for olaf sandbox smoke repos. One small, well-known public repo per supported ecosystem. Each repo must contain the listed manifest at (or under) its root so `olaf generate <clone> --offline` finds >= minPackages deps. Verified 2026-10-03 via GitHub contents API.

npm.note: Canonical npm web framework; package.json with runtime deps.

nuget.note: Official .NET test framework; recursive scan finds csproj files and packages.lock.json.

pip.note: Most popular Python HTTP library; pyproject.toml with dependencies.

go.note: Popular Go CLI library; go.mod with 4 requires.

cargo.note: Popular Rust grep tool; Cargo.toml with deps and Cargo.lock.

maven.note: Canonical Maven library; root pom.xml with test deps.

gradle.note: Popular mocking framework; Kotlin DSL build files plus version catalog.

composer.note: Canonical PHP logger (correct owner is Seldaek, not monolog org); composer.json with require on php/psr-log.

bundler.note: Well-known Ruby static site generator; Gemfile with gem entries.

swift.note: Swift server framework; Package.swift with ~24 .package(url:) deps. NOTE: apple/swift-argument-parser was rejected — it is a leaf package with zero .package deps, so olaf correctly reports 0.

cocoapods.note: Classic Objective-C sample app; root Podfile+lock with pods. NOTE: Alamofire/Alamofire was rejected — it ships only Alamofire.podspec (which olaf does not parse) and no Podfile.

vcpkg.note: Official Windows Terminal; root vcpkg.json with fmt/ms-gsl/jsoncpp/cli11/cmark deps. Depth-1 clone is large (~150MB) but one-time.

conan.note: Official Conan examples (default branch master); nested consumer conanfile.txt files, e.g. libraries/poco/md5/conanfile.txt requires poco/1.9.4. NOTE: catchorg/Catch2 was rejected — its root conanfile.py is a leaf recipe with no requires block, so olaf correctly reports 0.
